content:
I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
fit_coupon:
- I printed it, but I can't tell you how it came out.
plate:
- the clamp: I can't tell you how that one came out.
- the bolt's head: it fits in its recess.
- the roof the hole goes through: loose loops and tangles around the hole; hole partly closed.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

reasoning:
I'm working out how to stop the slot through the bridge roof from leaving loose loops around the hole. One approach is a sacrificial layer, and another is the bridging trick, where the counterbore ceiling is built in two staged layers so the slot edges get anchored properly.

I'm checking whether a strip-first bridging layout works for a slot counterbore, since the straight side walls only give a cantilever in one direction and not a true bridge. The round-hole case, where strips anchor at both ends on the circular wall, doesn't map cleanly onto this shape yet.

I'm sketching a two-layer bridge for the slot: first strips on either side of the slot's width spanning along the length, then a second layer filling the gap only past the slot ends. I'm also weighing a simpler route, a sacrificial membrane that gets drilled out, though shaping the slot through it is awkward.

Now I'm settling the layer dimensions: the first layer covers the counterbore stadium with a strip of width d left open, and the second layer is a rectangle of width d sized to the slot length, with the through slot cut upward from there.

I'm settling on a plain two-layer staging for the counterbore ceiling: layer one at 0.2 mm leaves a strip of hole width open, and layer two fills the gap beyond the slot length so it bridges across the width. I'm also considering adding a small roof coupon to test the approach before printing the full plate.

I'm going to write a shared helper inside each script, since every script stands on its own, and I'll add the bridge coupon as a separate block with the same counterbore and slot features.

{"params": {"plate_w":{"value":38,"kind":"world","source":"measured","note":"plate width the clamp takes (38 mm, Arca-Swiss style)"},"fit_clr":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"per side"},"plate_l":{"value":50,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"land":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bevel":{"value":4,"kind":"design","source":"guessed","note":"45 deg dovetail depth"},"bolt_d":{"value":6.35,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"1/4-20 major diameter"},"bolt_clr":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bolt_head_d":{"value":15,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"bolt_head_h":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"bolt_len":{"value":10,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"head_clr":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"the head fit; confirmed good"},"thread_engage":{"value":5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_travel":{"value":20,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"layer_h":{"value":0.2,"kind":"world","source":"asked","note":"printer layer height; sets the two stepped bridge layers"},"coupon_l":{"value":15,"kind":"design","source":"design"}}, "parts": [{"id":"plate","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat bottom on the bed; head recess opens at the bed","use_orientation":"bottom in the tripod clamp, camera on top","code":"def build(p):
    W = p.plate_w - 2*p.fit_clr
    b = p.bevel
    T = p.bolt_head_h + p.head_clr + (p.bolt_len - p.thread_engage)
    pts = [(-W/2,0),(W/2,0),(W/2,p.land),(W/2-b,p.land+b),(W/2-b,T),(-W/2+b,T),(-W/2+b,p.land+b),(-W/2,p.land)]
    body = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(pts).close().extrude(p.plate_l/2, both=True)
    d = p.bolt_d + p.bolt_clr
    hd = p.bolt_head_d + 2*p.head_clr
    H = p.bolt_head_h + p.head_clr
    Lcb = p.slot_travel + hd
    Ls = p.slot_travel + d
    lh = p.layer_h
    cb = cq.Workplane('XY').slot2D(Lcb, hd, 90).extrude(H + 1).translate((0,0,-1))
    # stepped bridge layer 1: open strip d wide along the full recess length (two side strips bridge along Y)
    s1 = cq.Workplane('XY').box(d, Lcb, lh + 0.02, centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,0,H-0.01))
    s1 = s1.intersect(cq.Workplane('XY').slot2D(Lcb, hd, 90).extrude(lh + 0.02).translate((0,0,H-0.01)))
    # layer 2: open only a rectangle the size of the slot (ends bridge across X)
    s2 = cq.Workplane('XY').box(d, Ls, lh + 0.02, centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,0,H+lh-0.01))
    slot = cq.Workplane('XY').slot2D(Ls, d, 90).extrude(T + 1).translate((0,0,H+2*lh-0.01))
    return body.cut(cb).cut(s1).cut(s2).cut(slot)
"},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat bottom on the bed","use_orientation":"dropped into the tripod clamp to test the fit","code":"def build(p):
    W = p.plate_w - 2*p.fit_clr
    b = p.bevel
    T = p.bolt_head_h + p.head_clr + (p.bolt_len - p.thread_engage)
    pts = [(-W/2,0),(W/2,0),(W/2,p.land),(W/2-b,p.land+b),(W/2-b,T),(-W/2+b,T),(-W/2+b,p.land+b),(-W/2,p.land)]
    return cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(pts).close().extrude(p.coupon_l/2, both=True)
